sloka: पलाशबदरीमिश्रम् रम्यम् वम्शैश्च यामुनैः ।स पन्थाश्चित्रकूटस्य गतः सुबहुशो मया ॥२-५५-९॥
transliteration: palāśabadarīmiśram ramyam vamśaiśca yāmunaiḥ ।sa panthāścitrakūṭasya gataḥ subahuśo mayā ॥2-55-9॥

translations.english: That path leads to Chitrakuta. I had travelled through it several times. It is beautiful, smooth and safe from forest fires.
